Xiao Xiao stands foremost among the Dragon-Blooded and holds the rank of Vast Heaven General. As a descendant and favoured disciple of the Lord of Shangyang, he tempered his body from childhood through the "Cinnabar Furnace Body-Refinement Method", forging sinews and veins until vast magical power flowed within him—of the same blazing origin as the Vermilion Bird’s sacred flames. His martial prowess stands unrivalled across the armies of the west, and generals of the Western Defence praise him as “invincible in valour, before whom treachery and corruption retreat.” Among his peers, only Xuan Lie’s raw ferocity ever forced him onto the back foot. Upon Zhao Ming’s command to serve under Miao Ying as campaign overseer, Xiao Xiao came to deeply admire the Storm Dragon’s wisdom and vision, and under her leadership he helped repel Chaos incursions time and again beyond the Great Bastion.

Golden helm and armour, purple-gold robes; violet eyes, white brows, azure mane. He stands like a jade pillar bearing the capital’s weight, strength enough to shoulder three mountains. His mount is of dragon stock—how could demons and vermin escape? War-drums thunder, banners flash like lightning, shaking land and sky. When triumph returns him home, I shall help the general unfasten his armour.
